text: Precision is TP/(TP+FP). Recall is TP/(TP+FN). A model can improve recall by lowering the decision threshold, at a cost in false positives.
F1 is the harmonic mean: 2PR/(P+R). It is useful when both precision and recall matter. A very high accuracy can conceal minority-class failure.
